technique_name: Compare and contrast Amazon and Alibaba
description: Amazon and Alibaba are both large e-commerce companies that have become leaders in the retail industry. Both companies have a huge presence on the internet and have expansive product catalogs and competitive prices. However, there are a few key differences between them. Amazon is more focused on providing a broad range of products while Alibaba is more focused on connecting buyers and sellers to one another and providing businesses with a platform to sell their products.
